On the basis of above facts, the applicants have apprehended that the police, at the instance of 2024:HHC:14265 2024:HHC:14266 complainant, is hell-bent to arrest them, in this case.
They have also asserted that they are having deep roots in the society.

8. In order to substantiate their stand, the photocopies of the orders, passed by the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Ludhiana, in the litigation, between applicant-Bhanu Kiran Khosla and complainant- Rahul Khosla, have also been annexed with the applications.

9. On the basis of above facts, certain undertakings have been given on behalf of applicants, for which, the applicants are ready to abide by, in case, any direction is issued to the police/I.O., in this case.

When put to notice, the police has filed the status report disclosing therein, that complainant-Rahul Khosla has moved the complaint, before the police, mentioning therein the following facts:-
"That the applicant is a peace loving person and is the resident of H.No.51, Club Road, Ludhiana (Punjab).
2.
That the accused Avinash Arora, Jaswant Arora are the brothers in law of the applicant and Rohit Arora is working with Avinasha Arora.
Mrs. Urvashi was earlier working at Una now posted at Regional Office Central Bank of India, Bharat Nagar Chowk, Ludhiana.

3. That the accused Avinasha Arora, Jaswant Arora alongwithBhanuKiran wife of the applicant by 2024:HHC:14265 2024:HHC:14266 consulting each other along with Rohit Arora,
had link in the Central Bank of India and are closely associated with Mrs. Urvashi.
The applicant Owns a car bearing registration No. HP-20-E-7649.

4 . That the all accused forged and fabricated the signature of the applicant and got a loan from Central Bank of India against the car of the applicant for an amounting to Rs.4,60,000/ and mis-utilized and misappropriated the said amount for their own use and with a motive to cheat the applicant.

At the time of applying the car loan by the accused nos.1, 2, 3, 4, 5 in connivance with each other intentionally and deliberately mentioned the mobile number of any other person in the said application, that the complainant could not receive any message while sanctioning the car loan also accused Avinash Arora (accused no 1) has also put a personal gurantee in the loan, which clearly shows the dishonest intention of the accused nos.
1, 2, 3, 4, 5. 5.

That the applicant never appeared before the Branch of the bank nor he put his any signature as his signatures have been forged by all the accused nos. 1 to 5 with a motive to defraud with the applicant knowingly well that they are not entitled to take the loan from the bank against the vehicle of the applicant.

6. That thereafter, the applicant came to know about the illegality committed by them, then the applicant approached to the bank and bank supplied photocopies of the loan documents and after going through the same, the applicant came to know that all the accused by hatching criminal conspiracy, forged and fabricated the signature of the applicant and received the heavy amount and they themselves have mis- utilized the funds.
They used the forged signature of the applicant as genuine and converted the same for their Own use.

The accused no.5 wife of the applicant namely Bhanukiran is assisting all the other accused nos.1 to 5 by supplying the Aadhar card, specimen signature, PAN Card and other relevant documents of the applicant from the house of the applicant.
Moreover, the accused nos.1 to 5 threatening the applicant to face with dire consequences.

7. That I Have got the documents from RTI in which my wife Bhanu Kiran Khosla, Avinash Arora and Jaswant Arora 2024:HHC:14265 2024:HHC:14266 has given statement Joint Commissioner (Law and Order) in which Avinash Arora has confirmed he is gurantor in the loan availed in my name alongwith that they have submitted documents: Form CR TEM, Delivery Chalan and Proform Invoice (Compliance Certificate), Letter of Joint Commissioner of Police (Law and Bhanu Kiran Khosla vs State Of Himachal Pradesh on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126763607/
3 Order), Ludhiana), The Manager, Central Bank of India, Santokhgarh Branch District, Una, Himachal Pradesh and compliance of pre- disturbsement terms of sanction which are not signed by me.

8. I have also recieved Bank document in which it is clearly mentioned that the loan was sanctioned by Urvashi Sharma, Manager,
central Bank of India which hereby attached with alongwith statement.
That I am also forwarding the Voice recording of Rohit Arora in which he agreed all is planned by Avinash  Arora.

9. That the accuseds nos.1 to in connivance with each other have committed offence u/s 420/465/466/467/468/471/ 506/120-B IPC by misusing the documents of the applicant as well as forging the signatures of the applicant and by obtaining the loan on the basis of the said documents and forged signatures.
It is therefore, prayed that the investigation of the application and FIR may be registered against the aforesaid persons and justice be provided to the applicant."
11. On the basis of above facts, police registered the case and thereafter, the criminal machinery swung into motion.

12. In the status report, filed on 06.11.2024, it has been mentioned that after registration of FIR,
statement of complainant-Rahul Khosla was recorded and account opening form, Aadhaar Card,
PAN Card, photocopies of Voter ID Card were also obtained from Central Bank of India, Branch Santoshgarh.

After perusing the said status report, vide order dated 06.11.2024, interim protection was granted to the applicants, by this Court, directing the IO to release the applicants, on bail, in the event of their arrest and the applicants had been directed to join the investigation on 07.11.2024 at 02:00 pm.
14.

Thereafter, on 13.11.2024, police has filed the supplementary status report, disclosing therein that on 09.11.2024, both the applicants had joined the investigation and on enquiry, they could not disclose about their account number, upon which, they have been directed to go to their respective houses and telephonically inform the bank account to the police.

However, on 10.11.2024, when the police has contacted Jaswant Arora on his mobile number, then, it has been found that the mobile number of SI Rajesh Kumar has been put in the blocklist, whereas, applicant-Bhanu Kiran Khosla has submitted the details of her bank account, as well as, bank account of Avinash Arora.
15. Thereafter, KYC and account opening form of applicants, from their banks, were obtained.

During investigation, when SI Rajesh Kumar, along with police officials, had reached at the houses of the applicants, the 2024:HHC:14265 2024:HHC:14266 door was not opened by applicant-Bhanu Kiran Khosla.

Thereafter, IO directed them to appear before the police at Una on 12.11.2024 at 11am.
16.
In the status report, which has been filed on 27.11.2024, the specimen signatures of applicants were obtained.

sentences.text: It is the further case of the police that despite joining the investigation, they are not disclosing about the material aspects of the crime, nor they are disclosing anything about their real brother-Avinash Arora.

18. In the status report, which has been filed on 05.12.2024, it has been disclosed by the applicants that Avinash Arora, who is their real brother, will come back on 27.12.2024 and he will join the investigation.
Mobile number of Avinash Arora is found to be switched off.
19. In the status report, which has been filed today, similar stand has been taken by the police.

20. Heard.
21.

Considering the relationship between the complainant and the applicants and the fact that the present case is stated to be the counter-blast of the proceedings, which have been initiated by applicant-Bhanu Kiran Khosla, who is not the stranger, but, wife of the 2024:HHC:14265 2024:HHC:14266 complainant, this Court is of the view that the police is not able to make out a case for custodial interrogation of the applicants, in this case.

22. So far as the allegations, which have been levelled against the applicants in the FIR in question,
are concerned, those will be proved during the trial.

23. No other case is stated to have been registered against the applicants and their bail applications cannot be rejected merely on the ground that the police could not nab their brother Avinash Arora.

24. Since, the applicants have joined the investigation, as per the directions of this Court, as such,
this Court is of the opinion that the interim orders, dated 06.11.2024, passed in both the cases, are liable to be confirmed.

sentences.text: Any of the observations, made hereinabove, shall not be taken as an expression of opinion, on the merits of the case, as these observations, are confined, only, to the disposal of the present bail applications.
26. The applicants are directed to move regular bail applications, when chargesheet will be filed in the competent Court of law.
27. It is made clear that the respondent-State is at liberty to move an appropriate application, in case, any of the bail conditions, is found violated by the applicants.
28. Copy of this order be placed in the connected case file i.e. CrMP(M) No.2471 of 2024.
